title: Chip-firing on the Lattice of Nonnegative Integer Points
summary: Chip-firing on a directed graph is a game in which chips, a discrete commodity, are placed on the vertices of the graph and are transferred between vertices. In this paper, we study a chip-firing game on the Hasse diagram of the lattice of nonnegative integer points on the plane, where we start with $2^n$ chips at the origin. When we fire a vertex $v$, we send one chip to each out-neighbor. We fire until we reach a stable configuration, a distribution of chips where no vertex can fire.
